body: There appears to be some overlap between V2.7 and the new V2.33, to the extent that V2.33 could be said to be fully contained in V2.7. I would suggest the removal of the the mention of "password managers" from V2.7, so that V2.7 focuses purely on the password fields themselves, and V2.33 on the password manager support.

comments.body: Thank you for this excellent and simple fix to ASVS. The change has been made and will appear in ASVS 3.1.

title: Overlap V2.7 and V2.33.
